text:
alex: Heads up — tenant invoice preview for tenant_42 jumped by ~2.4k tokens after an edge routing heartbeat delay. Seen in console preview around 14:03 UTC. Anyone on metering side?
li: Can repro, looks like the edge heartbeat delayed fanout so two shards replayed and both got counted; fingerprint dedupe window didn't catch it.
nina: Are we deduping by fingerprint+session? we currently use fingerprint + 30s window, heartbeats caused ~90s gap.
jamal: That's the issue. When shard A comes back it replays events with new routing tag and they get re-attributed. We need a stable routing tag in the event payload.
ops-bot: deploy status: metering-ingest v1.8.3 promoted to canary; dedupe-window=30s.
maria: Billing saw invoice-preview drift for several tenants, some got negative credits after promo application. Need a stop-gap so customers don't panic.
li: Short-term mitigation: mark console preview as "provisional" and add a "recompute preview" button. Long-term: extend dedupe window or add monotonic per-session seq id at edge.
alex: Suggestion: edge include event_seq + route_rev in payload so consumers can detect replays and only accept the highest route_rev per fingerprint.
jamal: Agree. Backwards compatibility: bump event schema v2 and include X-Route-Seq header. Meterer can ignore unknown fields until rollout.
nina: Also: meterer currently trusts approx_tokens computed at proxy. If proxy replays same request, approx_tokens duplicate. Could we instead send token_hash to detect duplicates without re-tokenizing?
li: Tokenization in meterer would be more accurate but increases CPU on ingest. token_hash would be a cheaper compromise.
alex: Quick repro logs pasted below: 
```
2026-03-18T14:03:12Z edge-1 INFO replay event tenant=tenant_42 fingerprint=abc123 route_rev=5 seq=0
2026-03-18T14:03:13Z ingest-2 INFO processed tokens=1200 fingerprint=abc123
2026-03-18T14:03:50Z edge-1 INFO heartbeat delayed 38s
2026-03-18T14:04:20Z edge-2 INFO replay event tenant=tenant_42 fingerprint=abc123 route_rev=6 seq=0
```
jamal: From the DB side we can short-circuit preview: when computing invoice-preview only include the latest route_rev per fingerprint. That should prevent double-counting in the UI while we fix ingestion.
maria: Agreed for preview. For final invoice commit we need a reconciliation/dedupe job before commit; otherwise we risk permanent double charges or wrong credits.
li: Proposed rollout plan: 1) Console: provisional preview + warning (hotfix) 2) Ingest change to prefer max(route_rev) for preview compute (canary) 3) Edge: add seq+route_rev header (staged rollout) 4) Longer-term: token_hash and move tokenization to meterer (perf evaluation).
alex: I'll open a PR for the console UX tonight. @maria can you draft the billing copy for the provisional preview state?
maria: Yep. Also want a dashboard alert that flags >5% preview delta vs finalized invoice in a 1h window.
ops-bot: created ticket MTR-3291 for ingest dedupe logic.
billing-bot: invoice-preview audits: tenant_42 delta +2432 tokens, tenant_78 delta -1200 tokens.
li: Thanks everyone. I'll run a canary tomorrow morning and loop in eng-sre for monitoring. :thumbsup:
